offense_injuries.espn_comment: Okereke (foot) didn't practice Thursday.
Head coach Dave Canales plans to take "the next two days" to discuss Horn (quadriceps), Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.
Legette (knee) was a full practice participant Thursday.
Brooks (groin) was a full practice participant Thursday.
The Panthers are designating Jackson (groin) to return from injured reserve Wednesday, opening his 21-day practice window, Alex Zietlow of The Charlotte Observer reports.
Young completed 28 of 39 passes for 276 yards and three touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos. He added 13 yards on his only carry and lost a fumble.
Lloyd posted eight tackles (five solo) and one pass defense during the Panthers' 26-21 loss to the Broncos in Week 9.
Lewis (knee) was a full participant in Wednesday's walkthrough practice.
McMillan caught four of six targets for 56 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos.
Hubbard carried the ball 16 times for 79 yards and caught four of five targets for 17 yards in Sunday's 26-21 loss to Denver.
Coker caught four of five targets for 29 yards in Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos.
Phillips (hamstring) was estimated as a full participant on Wednesday's practice report.
Tremble caught four of six targets for 24 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos.
Waller caught eight of 10 targets for 90 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos.
Evans caught both of his two targets for 20 yards during Sunday's 26-21 loss versus the Broncos.
Bullock (quadriceps) is active for Sunday's game versus Denver, Darin Gantt of the team's official site reports.
Lee (hamstring) was estimated as a full participant on Wednesday's practice report.
Etienne carried the ball two times for seven yards and returned one punt for nine yards during Carolina'a loss Sunday to the Broncos.
Simpkins (ankle) is available for Sunday's game against Denver, Darin Gantt of the team's official site reports.
Sanders recorded zero targets during Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos.
Fitzgerald missed his only field-goal attempt and went 3-for-3 on extra-point tries during Sunday's 26-21 loss to the Broncos.
Metchie caught both of his targets for 40 yards Sunday in a loss to the Broncos.

team_projection.note: Bootstrap of each team's real quarter scores. 'matchup_pair' includes the opponent's defence; 'independent' is the legacy sampler. No injuries, no weather, no fitted calibration. On 2026 weeks 1-8 neither sampler beat the market; treat probabilities near the market number as no information.
